intro: Bali is one of those places that stays with you long after the trip ends. Rice terraces, temples and surf beaches — and it is easier to plan than you might think.

sections.heading: Why visit Bali
paragraphs: Bali (Southeast Asia) is known for its beach, island and romantic experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is April to October (dry season).

sections.heading: Top things to do
list: Uluwatu Temple and Kecak dance at sunset

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Fly into Ngurah Rai International Airport (Denpasar); there are direct flights from some Indian cities.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Traffic is heavy — base yourself in two areas rather than doing day trips from one.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Bali?

faq.a: Fly into Ngurah Rai International Airport (Denpasar); there are direct flights from some Indian cities.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Bali?
faq.a: Popular choices: Ubud for culture and nature; Seminyak / Canggu for beach clubs; Uluwatu for cliffs and surf.
